# Arman Heidari (آرمان حیدری)

> Official academic profile and research portfolio of Arman Heidari.
> Website: https://armanheidari.ir

## Biography & Identification
- **Full Name**: Arman Heidari
- **Persian Name**: آرمان حیدری
- **Current Position**: M.Sc. Student in Artificial Intelligence at Sharif University of Technology (دانشگاه صنعتی شریف)
- **Undergraduate Degree**: B.Sc. in Computer Engineering, Allameh Tabataba'i University (دانشگاه علامه طباطبائی)
- **Undergraduate Honors**: First Rank in Computer Engineering Cohort (GPA: 3.96 / 4.00, 19.29 / 20.00; Major GPA: 19.35 / 20.00)
- **Location**: Tehran, Iran

## Core Research & Specializations
- **Artificial Intelligence & Deep Learning**: Neural representations, optimization, and generative models.
- **Reinforcement Learning**: Decision making in dynamic environments, policy optimization, autonomous agents.
- **Data & First-Principles Engineering**: Distributed ETL architectures, algorithmic design, discrete mathematics.
